name: Hamblen County, TN
findings: Hamblen County has 126 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Hamblen County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Hamblen County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list public events
observations.text: 2 social and fraternal organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 16 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
